title: Halchal Hai Fauje
body:
teero pe teer naizo par naize chalaate hai
halchal hai fauje shaam mein abbas aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kya waqt pad gaya hai mohamed ki aal par
chadar nahi hai baalon se moo ko chupate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko maa chupati hai jhuk jhuk ke godh mein
qaimon ko tod tod kar jab teer aate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pani pani hota hai bachon ka pyas se
sookhi zaban hoton par asghar phirate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode daudaye sham se lashkar jo aate hai
kam umr bache qaimon mein ghabraye jaate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ko de diya hai sabak ye hussain ne
raahe khuda mein kis tarha ghar ko lutaate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re sabr sayyede waala ka dekhle
ran mein jawan bete ka laasha uthate hai
halchal hai fauje…
